I was reluctant at first regarding this app! I was wrong. The reviews I read convinced me to give this app a chance even though some of the reviews seemed too good to be true! I installed it today and quickly figured out how I wanted to use it. I have many old photos on my device that I thought were “pretty good”. This app has made them sensational! Some of my family photos go back to the early 1920’s - tuning them up was very fast and the results were truly outstanding. I have been searching Google Photos and Amazon Photos for candidates for a tuneup. This is great stuff!
